AI Video Compressor — v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Compress and export videos with simple natural language instructions.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM video uploads up to 500MB.
- Automatic backend connection and session management.
- Exports 1080p MP4 files in 30–90 seconds via remote GPU nodes.
- Includes balance checks, file upload, export, and state/status retrieval.
